predeclaration_rule: Bind the controlled snowball edge taxonomy, parent-seed provenance rules, round metrics contract (Y_r, D_r, X_r, U_r, m_r), marginal-yield decomposition dimensions, and permitted stop descriptions before any A5 round yield is computed or interpreted. Post-hoc addition, deletion, or relabelling of edge types after seeing yield is prohibited. A snowball edge itself never establishes inclusion or canonical identity.

edge_types.label: Product to organization
edge_types.notes: Parent seed must be a validated PRODUCT offering ID. Generated organization objects re-enter as candidates only.

edge_types.label: Organization to other product
edge_types.notes: Organization expansion from a parent PRODUCT seed. Generated product objects re-enter as candidates; edge alone does not allocate canonical identity.

edge_types.label: Product to trial
edge_types.notes: A5 reporting edge type; F11 execution substrate combines trial/regulatory/publication into PRODUCT_TO_TRIAL_REGULATORY_PUBLICATION.

edge_types.label: Product to regulatory record
edge_types.notes: A5 reporting edge type; shares F11 PRODUCT_TO_TRIAL_REGULATORY_PUBLICATION substrate with PRODUCT_TO_TRIAL and PRODUCT_TO_PUBLICATION.

edge_types.label: Product to publication
edge_types.notes: A5 reporting edge type; shares F11 PRODUCT_TO_TRIAL_REGULATORY_PUBLICATION substrate.

edge_types.label: Product to distributor or procurement record
edge_types.notes: Distributor/procurement expansion under recorded parent PRODUCT seed.

edge_types.label: Product to related or competitor product candidate
edge_types.notes: Related/competitor/alternative candidate expansion. Generated objects re-enter as candidates only.

edge_types.label: Product to related capability query
edge_types.notes: Capability-query expansion from a parent PRODUCT seed; does not invent capability-family yield by implication.

metrics_contract.y_r_definition: Y_r = count of new validated products in round r: distinct canonical PRODUCT offering IDs with INCLUDE_RESOLVED that are absent from the known-identity set entering the round. Never raw edge or hit counts.
metrics_contract.d_r_definition: D_r = duplicate candidates in round r: known-identity duplicates plus within-round INCLUDE_RESOLVED duplicates (same offering ID).
metrics_contract.x_r_definition: X_r = excluded candidates in round r: captures with outcome EXCLUDE.
metrics_contract.u_r_definition: U_r = unresolved candidates in round r: captures with outcome UNRESOLVED_IDENTITY.
metrics_contract.candidates_r_definition: Candidates_r = raw candidate count in round r (all captures dispositioned in that round).
metrics_contract.m_r_definition: m_r = Y_r / Candidates_r (marginal new-identity yield). Fail closed when Candidates_r is zero.

decomposition_policy.by_source_frame: Attribute marginal yield to the capture frame_id (F11 for controlled snowball substrate).
decomposition_policy.by_language: Attribute using capture.language; fail closed to NOT_ATTRIBUTABLE when language is missing.
decomposition_policy.by_jurisdiction: Attribute using capture.jurisdiction; fail closed to NOT_ATTRIBUTABLE when jurisdiction is missing.
decomposition_policy.by_product_class: Attribute only when an exact product-class label is recorded on the candidate or known offering; otherwise NOT_ATTRIBUTABLE. Do not invent class from organization or edge type.
decomposition_policy.by_capability_family: Attribute only when the edge binds PRODUCT_TO_CAPABILITY_QUERY and a frozen capability family is recorded; otherwise NOT_ATTRIBUTABLE.

forbidden_completeness_claims: every relevant product worldwide has been found

boundary: A5 controlled snowball discovery preregistration freezes the edge taxonomy, parent-seed provenance rules, Y_r/D_r/X_r/U_r/m_r metrics contract, marginal-yield decomposition dimensions, and permitted stop descriptions under the A2 analysis universe before yield interpretation. It does not establish global completeness, market share, effectiveness, unseen-population size, commercialization, S2 publication authority, or v4.2 assessment effect. A snowball edge never establishes inclusion or canonical PRODUCT identity. Freeze alone does not compute round metrics. F11 remains estimator-excluded.
